refresh_seconds.label: Refresh every
refresh_seconds.description: How often subscription limits are checked. Spend services are checked at most every 5 minutes. Choose 0 / Manual only to stop automatic checks; use Refresh now when you want a check.

key_storage.label: API key storage
key_storage.description: Secret Service is recommended. Local files are unencrypted and mode 600; use only read-only, narrowly scoped and rotatable API keys.

show_header.label: Show header
show_header.description: Show the icon, title and buttons above the account sections.

show_details.label: Show details
show_details.description: Show the extra rows: tokens, plan, billing mode, top-up, member budgets and local model stats.

background_opacity.label: Panel opacity
background_opacity.description: Host panel opacity, applied live by Noctalia without reloading the widget.

show_percent.label: Show percentage
show_percent.description: Show the worst current limit next to the bar icon.

glyph.label: Icon
glyph.description: Glyph used by the bar widget.

mode.label: Bar value
mode.description: What the bar widget shows next to its icon.

card_opacity.label: Account section opacity
card_opacity.description: Background opacity behind each account section, from 0 (divider-only, HUD style) to 1 (solid card).

show_model_stats.label: Show local model stats
show_model_stats.description: For OpenCode Go, read the local OpenCode database with `opencode stats --json --models` and show the top models on this machine. This is local data, not official Go quota.

background.label: Show host panel
background.description: Let Noctalia draw its surface behind the card. Turn off to place the content directly on the desktop wallpaper.

show_reset_times.label: Show reset times
show_reset_times.description: Show the reset time under each limit bar.

show_service_icon.label: Show service icons
show_service_icon.description: Show a glyph for each provider in the account section header.

content_width.label: Content width
content_width.description: Width of the card content in logical px. Match this to the tile width in the desktop-widget editor for a tight fit (the host panel adds its own padding).

text_scale.label: Text size
text_scale.description: Multiplies every title, label, value, reset and detail font size (0.5–2.0) without changing the bar or divider dimensions.

divider_width.label: Divider thickness
divider_width.description: Thickness of the header, account and section dividers.

divider_color.label: Divider colour
divider_color.description: Colour of the header, account and section dividers. Accepts a hex colour or palette role.

divider_opacity.label: Divider opacity
divider_opacity.description: Opacity of the dividers, from 0 (invisible) to 1 (solid).

header_color.label: Header icon colour
header_color.description: Colour of the header badge outline and icon. Accepts a hex colour or palette role.

header_glyph.label: Header icon
header_glyph.description: Glyph shown in the header badge.

normal_color.label: Normal limit colour
normal_color.description: Colour of bars and values below the warning threshold. Accepts a hex colour or palette role.

warning_color.label: Warning limit colour
warning_color.description: Colour used from 75% used. Accepts a hex colour or palette role.

critical_color.label: Critical limit colour
critical_color.description: Colour used from 90% used, and for rejected keys and expired windows. Accepts a hex colour or palette role.

unknown_color.label: Unknown / expired colour
unknown_color.description: Colour for expired, disabled or unavailable values. Accepts a hex colour or palette role.

track_color.label: Bar track colour
track_color.description: Colour of the unfilled part of each limit bar. Accepts a hex colour or palette role.

track_opacity.label: Bar track opacity
track_opacity.description: Opacity of the unfilled part of each limit bar.

text_color.label: Primary text colour
text_color.description: Titles, values and labels. Accepts a hex colour or palette role.

muted_text_color.label: Secondary text colour
muted_text_color.description: Account labels, reset times, units and inactive values. Accepts a hex colour or palette role.

card_color.label: Account section colour
card_color.description: Fill colour used only when Account section opacity is above 0. Accepts a hex colour or palette role.

card_radius.label: Account section radius
card_radius.description: Corner radius of the optional account section surface.

card_border_color.label: Account section border colour
card_border_color.description: Border colour of the optional account section surface. Accepts a hex colour or palette role.

card_border_opacity.label: Account section border opacity
card_border_opacity.description: Border opacity of the optional account section surface, from 0 (no border) to 1.

card_border_width.label: Account section border width
card_border_width.description: Border thickness of the optional account section surface.

background_color.label: Panel colour
background_color.description: Host panel fill colour. Accepts a hex colour or palette role. Handled by Noctalia, not the plugin.

background_radius.label: Panel corner radius
background_radius.description: Host panel corner radius in logical px.

background_padding.label: Panel padding
background_padding.description: Space between the host panel edge and the card content in logical px.

model_stats_limit.label: Local models shown
model_stats_limit.description: How many local OpenCode Go models to show (1–20).

show_layout_settings.label: Show layout settings
show_layout_settings.description: Reveal content width and the optional account-section fill, radius and border.

show_colour_settings.label: Show colour settings
show_colour_settings.description: Reveal header, limit, track, text and divider colours.

show_scaling_settings.label: Show scaling settings
show_scaling_settings.description: Reveal text size, progress bar height and divider thickness. Current values stay active while hidden.

show_section_settings.label: Show section toggles
show_section_settings.description: Reveal the show header, details, reset times and service icons toggles. Current values stay active while hidden.
